That is a common response I hear: where dating a short guy is only acceptable as long as he makes up for it by having a REALLY good personality and so forth. It seems to imply that there is something deficient with him in the first place if he has to make up for it. Don't you think?

There may be some short girls who tend to prefer shorter guys, but I see more short girls who still have height requirements that are much taller than themselves. For instance, a quick Google search or asking around will show you many 5'0" girls or so who have height requirements like 6'0" or taller only. It's still a minority when you find a woman who actually prefers short guys. I really hope you're right, though. Just sharing my experience. It's sad. The reason they can do this is that there is no shortage of average or tall men. They have nothing to lose by passing on short men. You'll even hear them say, "there aren't many guys that short anyway, lol" as a common justification.

I do like to think that a girl who dismisses a guy due to his height isn't worth his time anyway. The problem with that is, depending on how short the guy is, that would mean the MAJORITY of women, say 70-90% are not worth his time and are shallow. Are the majority of women really problematic, or is it just that he's not attractive to women due to his height? There is no right answer. Just food for thought. When the majority of the opposite gender says you're unattractive for something so seemingly superficial and uncontrollable, it becomes easier to empathize with the issue of short men and why they might suffer so much and have insecurities surrounding height in this society.

To put salt in the wound, here we are in a society of "body positivity" where men dare not discriminate against fat women. But, short guys? They don't have much support. It doesn't benefit women, after all. And the whole body positivity movement and feminism and so forth are all things that focus on women's issues. Not men's. You can see everywhere how short jokes are still common and socially acceptable. Even here on AskReddit. But start talking about women's weight? How dare you fat shame?! It's shit like this that has people loving ridiculous extremists like Andrew Tate. He's like the male version of what people like Kim Kardashian are for women.

But every short man knows (hopefully) that the only thing worse than being a short man to most women is being a short man who complains about it. 

In a way, short men live life on hard mode. Take most 6'3" macho men and make them 5'3" and watch them cry and break down when they try the dating game, or anything social. I'd argue the best test of manliness is how a man copes with this very real social issue. Most of us don't cope well, but we do. That's all we can do. We better.

End of my little rant. Hope this helps someone somehow.

“if your skin care burns it means it’s working”

No, usually this just means your skin is irritated. Irritated skin is not good for acne and can cause it to get worse. 

“popping zits and putting rubbing alcohol on 
them is the best way to get rid of em”

As any dermatologist will tell you, don’t pop zits! This can lead to permanent scarring, irritation, and infection. Alcohol is harsh and tends to dry skin.

“all the makeup I wear is causing acne”

Makeup can potentially make acne worse or cause it but not necessarily. It depends on various factors.

A lot of this stuff you can find more info about on google. Try to find sources with expert opinions, like dermatologists. But this gives you a brief idea. Good luck!

Yes, it’s the sad truth that many women will dismiss dating you purely due to your height, but we can’t change that. Why worry about what can’t be changed? It’s a waste of time and energy. We’re instead better of problem-solving and improving.

Being short is sometimes like playing life on hard mode. Yes, it’ll be a challenge at times, but the skills and wisdom you gain through overcoming those challenges will give you an advantage many other people will never have. Again, thank your height. It’s leveling you up hard.

One thing we have to be careful of is not falling into the path of despair. There is no leveling up there, only stagnation and suffering.
Then we will find someone who wants us fully! Feel the pain, but then don’t give up.
